dedupe_keys.name: fluid structure interaction simulations for coastal structures

description: Fluid Structure Interaction Simulations for Coastal Structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). This project uses multi-physics simulations to study how waves interact with nearshore structures. The simulations account for the deformability of the structural members as well as soil flexibility effects that can be introduced by slender wood pile systems. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: wave action, wave forces, fluid structure interaction, elevated coastal structures, hurricane storm surge, wave action. Published 2024-03-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
